name: Historical Maps
description: Aged parchment period cartography with hand-drawn coastlines and frontiers, ornate compass rose, period-accurate place names, trade routes, battle lines, and empire territories as they existed at the time of the narrative. Never generic.
system_instructions: Execute as authentic historical period cartography on aged parchment: Hand-drawn sepia, brown, and black ink coastlines, frontiers, and topography on textured aged cream parchment or vellum. Features ornate nautical compass roses, rhumb lines, hand-lettered period typography, trade routes, battle lines, and empire boundaries as they were at the time of the story. Place names must be strictly period-accurate (no modern names where they did not exist; historical borders as they were then, not today). STRICTLY NO modern map looks, NO Google-Maps or GPS styling, NO modern roads or highways, NO satellite imagery, and NO modern country outlines. Every map visual MUST depict the specific geography discussed in the narration — never a decorative generic map. Stills are held completely still (never pan or zoom across the map; use real footage via VIDEO of / KEYWORDS if motion is needed).
